description:
Use this when the user asks what SEC filings came out recently — "any new 10-Ks, 10-Qs or 8-Ks this week?", "which of my portfolio companies filed since Monday?", "who reported earnings today?" — across all companies or a list of tickers, in one call. Also the building block for alerts and daily portfolio checks.

**Returns:** a flat list of {ticker, accession, filed_at, form_type, form_subtype}, newest filing date first and **largest companies first within a date** — a small `limit` still surfaces the largest filers. `form_subtype` classifies 8-Ks (values under `form_subtypes`); null for other forms.

**8-K items:** "Who filed Item 4.02 in 2025?" → `items=["4.02"], since="2025-01-01", until="2025-12-31"`. Rows carry item codes; their text may not be extracted yet.

**Portfolio filter:** `tickers` (an array; `ticker` is accepted as an alias, union, cap 50): one call, no per-ticker `list_filings` fan-out.

Read a row's filing with `get_filing_section(ticker, accession_number=...)` — omit `section_id` for its section outline. For every filing of ONE company, use `list_filings`.

Not point-in-time: the live feed as of today (one company as of a past date: `list_filings` with `vantage_date`).

form_subtypes.description: 8-K sub-type derived from section inventory. '8-K-earnings' = earnings release; '8-K-transcript' = earnings call transcript; '8-K-event' = M&A / exec changes / debt; '8-K-other' = misc. Implies 8-K filings only.

form_types.description: Filter by SEC form type, e.g. ['8-K', '10-Q'].

items.description: 8-K item codes, any match, e.g. ['4.02'] restatements, ['2.06'] impairments. Not with form_subtypes.

offset.description: Next page: the offset a reply gives when more filings match (max 1000).

since.description: Filing date floor (inclusive), the SEC filing date. YYYY-MM-DD; omit for the last 30 days. Some filings (mostly 8-K and 6-K exhibits) are extracted days or weeks late: look back up to a month and dedupe by accession.

tickers.description: Optional portfolio filter. Up to 50 tickers.

name: list_recent_filings
title: Recent Filings Feed
